_comment: Hand-authored release manifest TEMPLATE. Tracked by git. Every field here is a human decision. Scripts/build-release.sh copies this file and adds the computed fields (checksums, sizes, sourceCommit, releaseTag, buildDate, buildInvocationID, treeState) to produce dist/latest.json, which is NEVER committed -- a tracked file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that adds it, and trying made the manifest permanently one commit stale. See Documentation/RELEASE_PROVENANCE.md.
knownLimitations: Unsigned, not notarized: Gatekeeper will block first launch (see Documentation/INSTALL_UNSIGNED.md).
Built and tested on a single physical Mac (arm64) — no multi-OS or multi-hardware verification performed.
No public release exists; this manifest has no downloadURL because there is nothing to download it from publicly.

The DMG carries its Living System background and volume icon, but no saved icon positions: writing those needs the Finder, which refused automation in the build environment. Drag-and-drop works regardless.
Publication is blocked by design: no trademark search has been run for the name, legalReviewStatus is 'pending', and legal identity plus a security contact are undefined.
